notes: Rod minigame coverage: Xorcist (static-meter supercharge policy), RecordBreaker (notch-vs-target rotation timing via right-click), Maelstrom (charge-aware release gate), and a rewritten Pinion's Aria that enumerates live notes instead of looking them up by name. Updater runs the Inno Setup installer silently and relaunches; macro start verifies the rod against the hotbar before equipping; attach prefers the windowed Roblox client when a launcher stub is also running.
